items.reason: A gentle, non-active cleanser keeps skin feeling clean without adding to the tenderness on the jaw.
A mineral SPF helps keep the look of marks from appearing darker or more noticeable in the sun.

response.routine_note: Deep, painful lumps that leave marks are best looked at by a dermatologist, and nothing we sell is a stronger substitute for that, so I've kept this to gentle basics instead of adding strong products. Use the cleanser morning and night, apply the SPF each morning, and avoid scrubs or harsh exfoliants on the area.
